# Kubernetes (EKS/On-Prem), Internal RFC1918 Subnets & Split-Horizon DNS (`onprem-k8s-network-rfc1918`)

> **Group:** II. Identity, Gateways & Multi-Cloud / On-Prem
> **Product Archetypes:** Cloud_Infra_IaC, OnPrem_Enterprise_Network
> **Trigger Signals:** kubernetes, k8s, helm, docker, container, rfc1918, 10.135, 10.133, 10.228, 10.250, vpc, subnet, onprem

## [ BLOCK: internal-dns-leak-and-vpc-colocation ]
### Split-Horizon DNS Leaks (RFC1918 10.x) & High-Blast VPC Co-Location
- Identify internal hostnames (`10.135.x.x`, `10.133.x.x`, `10.228.x.x`, `10.250.x.x`) leaked in public DNS, config files, or OpenAPI `servers[]` blocks.
- Assess co-location blast radius where critical control planes (ArgoCD, Central Auth, KMS, Core DB, Doris/Flink/Superset) share the same internal IP or K8s node without NetworkPolicy isolation.

## [ BLOCK: k8s-manifests-helm-and-service-mesh ]
### Kubernetes RBAC, Pod Security, ServiceAccount Tokens & East-West Trust
- Audit Helm charts and K8s manifests for `privileged: true`, hostPath mounts, automounted ServiceAccount tokens, and unauthenticated internal service ports (`:8000`, `:8202`).

## [ BLOCK: k8s-secrets-logging-and-container-escape ]
### Kubernetes Secret Exposure, Audit Logging & Pod-to-Node Escalation
- Check K8s manifests and ConfigMaps for plaintext credentials, database URLs, or private keys committed in git.
- Verify `NetworkPolicy` enforcement isolating internet-facing pods from internal RFC1918 control planes (`10.x.x.x`), databases, and OT gateways.

### Standard Mappings
- OWASP-API8:2023, ASVS-V14, ASVS-V16, IEC-62443-3-3, CWE-250, CWE-668

### Safe Patterns (Refutation Anchors)
- Pod securityContext with runAsNonRoot: true, allowPrivilegeEscalation: false, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, and automountServiceAccountToken: false
- Default-deny Kubernetes NetworkPolicies restricting east-west pod traffic to explicit service ports and namespaces
- Secrets injected via External Secrets Operator / Vault / KMS rather than plaintext values.yaml

### Vulnerable Patterns
- Containers running with privileged: true, hostNetwork: true, or docker.sock / hostPath volume mounts
- ClusterRoleBinding granting cluster-admin or wildcard secrets/pods verbs to default application ServiceAccounts
- Internal RFC1918 IPs (10.x.x.x) and unauthenticated internal service ports exposed in public DNS or OpenAPI specs

### Mandatory Evidence (`required_evidence`)
- ev_... excerpt of Kubernetes Deployment/Pod/Helm chart manifests showing securityContext, volumes, and RBAC bindings
- ev_... excerpt of NetworkPolicy or Ingress/Service definitions

### Verification Questions When Static Code Is Inconclusive (`questions_when_unclear`)
- Are Pod Security Standards (Restricted) or Kyverno/OPA Gatekeeper admission policies enforced at the cluster level?
- Do VPC security groups or hardware firewalls segment the 10.x subnets between staging and production?
